summary: Retain owner-visible source resolution history and pin delegation compatibility

rules.detail: One shared ownership precedence walk keeps the public read resolver on its original full mission view, errors and read tracking. The new writer-only scalar requester lookup restores the same current-generation inner join, pinned by an authored status/prefix/missing-generation comparison. Denial writer fences remain unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Attention and unfiltered Now history HTTP reads now page resolved sender withdrawals/delegated denial dismissals, instead of treating history as open. Closed resources use attention/closed/CLAIM_ID and direct owner-fenced detail. Existing attention fields/enums are reused; no new SDK model shape in this follow-up. Sparse pages require following next_cursor.

manual.detail: No real delegated diagnostic before Operations verifies compatible builds across all admitted and eligible replication receivers, including offline/rejoin scope. Existing curator decision ask remains required; no new grant or capability is invented.

recovery.detail: Retained source reads preserve original update/denial text, resolution attribution, instruction and episode in the owner client. Existing durable and cited-evidence retention is reused, with no reader writes or new retention rule. Old-registry signed exchange outcome is pinned by an authored UNRUN control.
